name: Why are finished basements in Parker and Centennial especially vulnerable during storms?

mainEntity.name: Why are finished basements in Parker and Centennial especially vulnerable during storms?

acceptedAnswer.text: In communities like Centennial, Parker, and Greenwood Village, severe hail storms and sudden torrential rains can overwhelm window wells, roof vents, and basement egress windows. In these lower elevations, storm runoff can back up and pool against basement foundations, leading to finished basement flooding and lower-wall drywall saturation. If water enters your basement, HH Remodeling can tear away wet baseboards, remove bottom sections of drywall, inspect perimeter framing, and rebuild finished basement spaces with resilient tile, trim, and moisture-resistant wallboard to help guard against future seasonal runoff.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basements in these areas are susceptible to sudden heavy runoff overtopping window wells and soaking lower drywall, baseboards, and subfloors.
